definitions.explanation: The sacred text of Christianity, comprising the Old and New Testaments. In Japanese, this word specifically refers to the Christian Bible.

examples.japanese: {聖書|せいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だ。
examples.english: Reading the Bible is my daily routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聖書|せいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてあった→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There was a Bible placed in the hotel room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聖書|せいしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: This novel contains many quotations from the Bible.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to the Christian Bible. The word is also used figuratively to mean an authoritative or definitive reference in a field (e.g., 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{聖書|せいしょ}だ」 — "This book is the bible of programming").
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{清書|せいしょ}→清書：04326_seisho⟧ (fair copy — making a clean, final copy of a document).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖書|せいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (read the Bible)
- ⟦{旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}→旧約聖書：24049_kyuuyakuseisho⟧ (Old Testament)
- ⟦{新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}→新約聖書：24050_shinyakuseisho⟧ (New Testament)
- {聖書|せいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧ (teachings of the Bible)
